headline: MaineDOT switches to steel girders after Old Town bridge failure
dek: The agency says conventional steel is the quickest path to complete both Llewellyn Estes bridges while engineers continue investigating the August span failure.
body: MaineDOT will use conventional steel girders to finish both bridges in the Llewellyn Estes replacement project over the Stillwater River in Old Town, the department announced Thursday. The decision follows the August 13 failure of a span while concrete was being placed for the deck.

Commissioner Dale Doughty approved an engineering assessment team's recommendation that steel offers the most expeditious route because the bridge supports are already in place. MaineDOT says the adjacent span on the affected bridge must also be removed and replaced, while the girders for the second bridge share the same design, fabrication and material properties and will not be used until the cause of the failure is understood.

The engineering assessment remains open. MaineDOT says the steel decision does not determine why the span failed or assign responsibility, and the department is still working with project partners on the contributing factors. Cleanup and demolition will begin after the contractor's final plan is approved and specialized equipment is mobilized.

An updated completion schedule and cost estimate were not available with the announcement. The department said the steel option is intended to limit additional delays and costs for bridge users. The replacement structures carry Stillwater Avenue over two channels of the river; traffic is currently using a temporary bridge that was not affected by the August incident.

MaineDOT's incident FAQ says one worker suffered a broken ankle and two others had minor injuries when the under-construction span failed. The new bridge was not open to motorists at the time, and the temporary bridge remains the route for traffic while the replacement work is reassessed.
author: NorthEast News Desk
seoTitle: MaineDOT chooses steel girders for Old Town bridge project
seoDescription: MaineDOT will use conventional steel girders to complete the Old Town Stillwater River bridge project after an August span failure.
